cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all phenomena, often described as the source of all existence and change.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a cosmic order that is beyond human comprehension and cannot be fully expressed in words.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical or metaphorical route taken by a person or thing.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies movement along a defined trajectory, often with a directional or purposive quality.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The road is distant and dangerous, not to be lightly traversed.|This path connects the mountains and rivers, accessible to all.|Travelers advance along the road, encountering no obstruction.|Ancient people followed the path in their dwelling, never departing from their roots.
cards.Sentences: 道遠而險，不可輕行。|此道通於山川，人皆可達。|行者沿道而進，無有阻礙。|古之人，循道而居，不離其本。
